name: p2p-trust-stack
description: P2P Trust Stack — a libp2p-based Trust Spanning Protocol (TSP) stack: decentralized DID creation and rotation, an encrypted SQLite keystore, relationships/OOBI, Verified Trust Communities and verifiable credentials.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @p2p-trust-stack/core && npm run build --workspace @p2p-trust-stack/app-api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspace @p2p-trust-stack/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @p2p-trust-stack/app-api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @p2p-trust-stack/core && npm run test --workspace @p2p-trust-stack/app-api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke:pack
